title: Formalizing the Sampling Design Space of Diffusion-Based Generative Models via Adaptive Solvers and Wasserstein-Bounded Timesteps
abstract: arXiv:2602.12624v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Diffusion-based generative models have achieved remarkable performance across various domains, yet their practical deployment is often limited by high sampling costs. While prior work focuses on training objectives or individual solvers, the broader sampling design problem, specifically solver selection and scheduling, remains largely governed by static heuristics. We propose SDM, a principled, training-free sampling framework that adapts both the numerical solver and the timestep schedule to the intrinsic properties of the diffusion trajectory. By analyzing the PF-ODE dynamics, we show that velocity variation is small in high-noise stages and increases near the data manifold, identifying intervals where solver order is most consequential. In parallel, we introduce an offline-calibrated adaptive scheduling method that explicitly controls the local Wasserstein discretization error and projects the calibrated trajectory to a prescribed

translated_title: 通过自适应求解器与 Wasserstein 有界时间步形式化扩散生成模型的采样设计空间
translated_abstract: 基于扩散的生成模型在各个领域取得了卓越的性能，但其实际部署往往受到高昂采样成本的限制。以往的工作主要关注训练目标或单个求解器，而更广泛的采样设计问题——特别是求解器选择与时间步调度——在很大程度上仍由静态启发式方法主导。我们提出了 SDM，一个无需训练的、有原则的采样框架，它使数值求解器和时间步调度都能自适应扩散轨迹的内在特性。通过分析 PF-ODE 动力学，我们证明了速度变化在高噪声阶段较小，而在接近数据流形时增大，从而识别出求解器阶数最为关键的区间。与此同时，我们引入了一种离线校准的自适应调度方法，该方法显式控制局部 Wasserstein 离散化误差，并将校准后的轨迹投影到预定的（流形上）。
tldr: 提出了无需训练的采样框架 SDM，通过自适应选择数值求解器并基于 Wasserstein 离散化误差界校准时间步调度，形式化了扩散生成模型的采样设计空间，从而在保持生成质量的同时降低采样成本。
en_tdlr: Proposes SDM, a training-free sampling framework that formalizes the sampling design space of diffusion-based generative models by adaptively selecting numerical solvers and calibrating timestep schedules with Wasserstein-bounded discretization errors, reducing sampling costs while preserving generation quality.
